_about: Configuration for scripts/governance_docs.py (DOC-G1, DOC-G2, DOC-G4, DOC-G5, DOC-G6).
Copy this file to docs/governance/docs-policy.json and edit it. The copy is
project-owned: the harness never manages it, so your edits are not drift.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the gate.
link_roots        DOC-G1: files or directories whose relative Markdown links must resolve.
metadata_roots    DOC-G2: directories whose Markdown must carry lifecycle frontmatter.
legacy_missing_frontmatter_max  DOC-G2 ratchet: how many files may still lack frontmatter.
Lower it as you migrate; never raise it.
seal_roots        DOC-G4: git pathspec limiting the sealed-event immutability check.
portability_roots DOC-G5: directories that must not contain machine-bound home paths.
environment_owner DOC-G5: the one file allowed to name absolute home paths.
spec_homes        DOC-G6: every candidate specification home in this repository.
An empty list skips the gate.
spec_home         DOC-G6: the one home that owns present-tense requirement truth.
null means undeclared: the gate then only refuses two populated homes.
